spec.title: Pool state over time
spec.description: Warm health cue: available should sit at kubesandbox_pool_target

spec.title: Provision latency (p50/p95)
spec.description: Approximate: warm create -> first reconcile observing workspaceReady

spec.title: Reconcile errors
spec.description: By stage: reconcile (whole-pass list failure) plus per-item failures (provision/recycle/trim/marker_gc) that are otherwise only logged.

spec.title: 5xx error ratio
spec.description: Long-lived SSE streams (/events) are excluded so their multi-minute durations don't distort the ratio.

spec.title: Request latency (p50/p95/p99)
spec.description: SSE stream routes (/events) are excluded: they stay open for minutes and would otherwise land in the +Inf bucket and pin the quantiles.

spec.title: POST /api/sessions outcomes
spec.description: 201 = assigned from warm pool, 202 = queued, 409 = duplicate

spec.title: In-flight requests
spec.description: Includes open SSE streams; http_server_active_requests carries no http_route label, so streams can't be filtered out here. Cross-reference the 'SSE streams' panel.
